_help: Website-only settings. Services themselves come from KF Ledger (data/catalog.json is written by the Publish script). Use 'categories' to give a Ledger category a public name and one-line blurb, 'order' to set the order on the site, and 'hide_services' for Ledger service IDs that should not appear on the website. A new Ledger category with no entry here still shows, under its Ledger name.
